static readstat_error_t sav_parse_very_long_string_record(void *data, size_t count, sav_ctx_t *ctx) {
    char *p = data;
    char *end = p + count;
    while (p < end) {
        char *key_start = p;
        char *key_end = memchr(p, '=', end - p);
        if (key_end == NULL) {
            break;
        }
        char *val_start = key_end + 1;
        char *val_end = memchr(val_start, '\t', end - val_start);
        if (val_end == NULL) {
            val_end = end;
        }
        size_t key_len = key_end - key_start;
        size_t val_len = val_end - val_start;
        char temp_key[256];
        if (key_len >= sizeof(temp_key)) {
            key_len = sizeof(temp_key) - 1;
        }
        memcpy(temp_key, key_start, key_len);
        temp_key[key_len] = '\0';
        char temp_val[256];
        if (val_len >= sizeof(temp_val)) {
            val_len = sizeof(temp_val) - 1;
        }
        memcpy(temp_val, val_start, val_len);
        temp_val[val_len] = '\0';
        int temp_val_int = atoi(temp_val);
        varlookup_t *found = bsearch(temp_key, table, var_count, sizeof(varlookup_t), &compare_key_varlookup);
        if (found) {
            ctx->varinfo[found->index]->string_length = temp_val_int;
            ctx->varinfo[found->index]->write_format.width = temp_val_int;
            ctx->varinfo[found->index]->print_format.width = temp_val_int;
        }
        p = val_end + 1;
    }
    return READSTAT_OK;
}
</EVENT>

static readstat_error_t sav_set_n_segments_and_var_count(sav_ctx_t *ctx) {
    int i;
    int var_count = 0;
    for (i=0; i<ctx->var_index; i++) {
        spss_varinfo_t *info = ctx->varinfo[i];
        if (info->type == READSTAT_TYPE_STRING) {
            if (info->string_length > 255) {
                info->n_segments = (info->string_length + 251) / 252;
            } else {
                info->n_segments = 1;
            }
        }
        var_count += info->n_segments;
    }
    ctx->var_count = var_count;
    return READSTAT_OK;
}
</EVENT>
